paper_title: Direct Detection of Dark Photon Dark Matter with the James Webb Space Telescope
notes: Projected 95% C.L. sensitivity for a modified JWST mirror configuration (ground-testing) to dark photon dark matter kinetic mixing epsilon over 10-500 THz (m_A' ~ 0.04-2 eV). Two projection curves: JWST-MIRI (~10-60 THz, lower mass) and JWST-NIRSpec (~100-500 THz, higher mass). No numeric table given; data_points estimated from Fig.4 (randomized polarization scheme) and the abstract's stated range epsilon ~ 1e-12 to 1e-14. Masses converted from frequency via m=4.136e-15*f. DM density not explicitly stated in excerpt; assumed standard 0.3 GeV/cm^3.
